verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י נֶ֚פֶשׁ תֶחֱטָ֔א וּמָעֲלָ֥ה מַ֖עַל בַּיהוָ֑ה וְכִחֵ֨שׁ בַּעֲמִית֜וֹ בְּפִקָּד֗וֹן בִתְשׂ֤וּמֶת יָד֙ אֽוֹ־ בְגָזֵ֔ל א֖וֹ א֣וֹ עָשַׁ֥ק אֶת־ עֲמִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ne·p̄eš ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā ū·mā·‘ă·lāh ma·‘al Yah·weh wə·ḵi·ḥêš ba·‘ă·mî·ṯōw bə·p̄iq·qā·ḏō·wn ḇiṯ·śū·meṯ yāḏ ’ōw- ḇə·ḡā·zêl ’ōw ’ōw ‘ā·šaq ’eṯ- ‘ă·mî·ṯōw
verses.literal: If someone sins and acts unfaithfully against the LORD by deceiving his neighbor in regard to a deposit or security entrusted to him or stolen . . . or if he extorts - his neighbor

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ מָצָ֧א אֲבֵדָ֛ה וְכִ֥חֶשׁ בָּ֖הּ וְנִשְׁבַּ֣ע עַל־ שָׁ֑קֶר עַל־ לַחֲטֹ֥א אַחַ֗ת מִכֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ בָהֵֽנָּה׃ הָאָדָ֖ם יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- mā·ṣā ’ă·ḇê·ḏāh wə·ḵi·ḥeš bāh wə·niš·ba‘ ‘al- šā·qer ‘al- la·ḥă·ṭō ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ḇā·hên·nāh hā·’ā·ḏām ya·‘ă·śeh
verses.literal: or finds lost property and lies about it and swears - falsely - or if he commits any such sin . . . . . . that . . . a man might commit

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ כִּֽי־ יֶחֱטָ֣א וְאָשֵׁם֒ וְהֵשִׁ֨יב אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּזָ֗ל הַגְּזֵלָ֜ה א֤וֹ אֶת־ הָעֹ֙שֶׁק֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׁ֔ק א֚וֹ אֶת־ הַפִּקָּד֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָפְקַ֖ד אִתּ֑וֹ א֥וֹ אֶת־ הָאֲבֵדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî- ye·ḥĕ·ṭā wə·’ā·šêm wə·hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ’ă·šer gā·zāl hag·gə·zê·lāh ’ōw ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·šeq ’ă·šer ‘ā·šāq ’ōw ’eṯ- hap·piq·qā·ḏō·wn ’ă·šer hā·p̄ə·qaḏ ’it·tōw ’ōw ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇê·ḏāh ’ă·šer mā·ṣā
verses.literal: - once he has sinned and becomes guilty he must return - what . . . he has stolen or - - - taken by extortion or - the deposit - entrusted to him or - the lost property - he found

verses.original: א֠וֹ מִכֹּ֞ל עָלָיו֮ אֲשֶׁר־ יִשָּׁבַ֣ע לַשֶּׁקֶר֒ בְּרֹאשׁ֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ יֹסֵ֣ף וַחֲמִשִׁתָ֖יו עָלָ֑יו יִתְּנֶ֖נּוּ לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר ה֥וּא ל֛וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אַשְׁמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw mik·kōl ‘ā·lāw ’ă·šer- yiš·šā·ḇa‘ laš·še·qer bə·rō·šōw wə·šil·lam ’ō·ṯōw yō·sêp̄ wa·ḥă·mi·ši·ṯāw ‘ā·lāw yit·tə·nen·nū la·’ă·šer hū lōw bə·yō·wm ’aš·mā·ṯōw
verses.literal: or anything else about which he has sworn falsely He must make restitution in full - add a fifth of the value and pay it to the owner . . . . . . on the day [he acknowledges] his guilt

verses.original: וְאֶת־ יָבִ֖יא אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃ אֲשָׁמ֥וֹ לַיהוָ֑ה תָּמִ֧ים אַ֣יִל בְּעֶרְכְּךָ֥ מִן־ הַצֹּ֛אן לְאָשָׁ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- yā·ḇî ’el- hak·kō·hên ’ă·šā·mōw Yah·weh tā·mîm ’a·yil bə·‘er·kə·ḵā min- haṣ·ṣōn lə·’ā·šām
verses.literal: - Then he must bring to the priest his guilt offering to the LORD an unblemished ram of proper value from the flock -

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְנִסְלַ֣ח ל֑וֹ עַל־ אַחַ֛ת מִכֹּ֥ל אֲשֶֽׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה לְאַשְׁמָ֥ה בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·nis·laḥ lōw ‘al- ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kōl ’ă·šer- ya·‘ă·śeh lə·’aš·māh ḇāh
verses.literal: In this way the priest will make atonement for him before the LORD and he will be forgiven for anything . . . - he may have done to incur guilt

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: צַ֤ו אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָעֹלָ֑ה הָעֹלָ֡ה הִ֣וא עַל֩ עַל־ מוֹקְדָ֨ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כָּל־ הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וְאֵ֥שׁ תּ֥וּקַד הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣaw ’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw lê·mōr zōṯ tō·w·raṯ hā·‘ō·lāh hā·‘ō·lāh hî ‘al ‘al- mō·wq·ḏāh ham·miz·bê·aḥ kāl- hal·lay·lāh ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer wə·’êš tū·qaḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ bōw
verses.literal: Command - Aaron - and his sons . . . [that] this is the law of the burnt offering The burnt offering . . . is to remain on the hearth of the altar all night until morning and the fire must be kept burning on the altar

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלָבַ֨שׁ בַ֗ד מִדּ֣וֹ בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי־ עַל־ בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וְהֵרִ֣ים אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הַדֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָעֹלָ֖ה עַל־ הָאֵ֛שׁ אֶת־ תֹּאכַ֥ל וְשָׂמ֕וֹ אֵ֖צֶל הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên wə·lā·ḇaš ḇaḏ mid·dōw ḇaḏ yil·baš ū·miḵ·nə·sê- ‘al- bə·śā·rōw wə·hê·rîm ’eṯ- ham·miz·bê·aḥ had·de·šen ’ă·šer hā·‘ō·lāh ‘al- hā·’êš ’eṯ- tō·ḵal wə·śā·mōw ’ê·ṣel ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: And the priest shall put on his linen robe and linen . . . undergarments . . . . . . and he shall remove - from the altar the ashes - of the burnt offering . . . that the fire - has consumed and place them beside [it]

verses.original: וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְלָבַ֖שׁ אֲחֵרִ֑ים בְּגָדִ֣ים וְהוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙שֶׁן֙ מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל־ אֶל־ טָהֽוֹר׃ מָק֖וֹם
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ā·šaṭ ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·lā·ḇaš ’ă·ḥê·rîm bə·ḡā·ḏîm wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- had·de·šen mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ’el- ’el- ṭā·hō·wr mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: Then he must take off - his garments put on other clothes and carry - the ashes outside the camp . . . to a ceremonially clean place

verses.original: וְהָאֵ֨שׁ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד־ בּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וּבִעֵ֨ר עֵצִ֖ים עָלֶ֧יהָ וְעָרַ֤ךְ הָֽעֹלָ֔ה עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ וְהִקְטִ֥יר חֶלְבֵ֥י הַשְּׁלָמִֽים׃ עָלֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’êš ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ tū·qaḏ- bōw lō ṯiḵ·beh bab·bō·qer bab·bō·qer hak·kō·hên ū·ḇi·‘êr ‘ê·ṣîm ‘ā·le·hā wə·‘ā·raḵ hā·‘ō·lāh ‘ā·le·hā wə·hiq·ṭîr ḥel·ḇê haš·šə·lā·mîm ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning it must not be extinguished Every morning . . . the priest is to add wood to the fire arrange the burnt offering on it and burn the fat portions of the peace offerings on it

verses.original: אֵ֗שׁ תּוּקַ֥ד עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תָּמִ֛יד לֹ֥א תִכְבֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’êš tū·qaḏ ‘al- ham·miz·bê·aḥ tā·mîḏ lō ṯiḵ·ḇɛh
verses.literal: The fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually it must not be extinguished

verses.original: וְזֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַמִּנְחָ֑ה אַהֲרֹן֙ בְּנֵֽי־ הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤הּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֖י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ham·min·ḥāh ’a·hă·rōn bə·nê- haq·rêḇ ’ō·ṯāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’el- pə·nê ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Now this is the law of the grain offering Aaron’s sons shall present it before the LORD in front of the altar

verses.original: וְהֵרִ֨ים בְּקֻמְצ֗וֹ מִמֶּ֜נּוּ מִסֹּ֤לֶת הַמִּנְחָה֙ וּמִשַּׁמְנָ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַלְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְהִקְטִ֣יר אַזְכָּרָתָ֖הּ הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ נִיחֹ֛חַ רֵ֧יחַ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·rîm bə·qum·ṣōw mim·men·nū mis·sō·leṯ ham·min·ḥāh ū·miš·šam·nāh wə·’êṯ kāl- hal·lə·ḇō·nāh ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·min·ḥāh wə·hiq·ṭîr ’az·kā·rā·ṯāh ham·miz·bê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest is to remove a handful of fine flour - and olive oil - together with all the frankincense from the grain offering and burn the memorial portion on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֑יו יֹאכְל֖וּ וְהַנּוֹתֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔נָּה תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ מַצּ֤וֹת קָדֹ֔שׁ בְּמָק֣וֹם יֹאכְלֽוּהָ׃ בַּחֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד
verses.transliteration: ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw yō·ḵə·lū wə·han·nō·w·ṯe·reṯ mim·men·nāh tê·’ā·ḵêl maṣ·ṣō·wṯ qā·ḏōš bə·mā·qō·wm yō·ḵə·lū·hā ba·ḥă·ṣar ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Aaron and his sons are to eat the remainder It must be eaten without leaven in a holy place they are to eat it in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖הּ חֶלְקָ֛ם מֵאִשָּׁ֑י הִ֔וא קֹ֤דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים֙ כַּחַטָּ֖את וְכָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯê·’ā·p̄eh ḥā·mêṣ nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·ṯāh ḥel·qām mê·’iš·šāy hî qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·ḵā·’ā·šām
verses.literal: It must not be baked with leaven I have assigned - it as their portion of My food offerings It [is] most holy like the sin offering and the guilt offering

verses.original: כָּל־ זָכָ֞ר בִּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכֲלֶ֔נָּה עוֹלָם֙ חָק־ מֵאִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֥ע בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- zā·ḵār biḇ·nê ’a·hă·rōn yō·ḵă·len·nāh ‘ō·w·lām ḥāq- mê·’iš·šê Yah·weh lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem kōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ bā·hem yiq·dāš
verses.literal: Any male among the sons of Aaron may eat it This is a permanent portion from the food offerings to the LORD for the generations to come Anything that touches them will become holy

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: זֶ֡ה קָרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּבָנָ֜יו אֲשֶׁר־ יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽיהוָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔וֹ עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָאֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת תָּמִ֑יד מִנְחָ֖ה מַחֲצִיתָ֣הּ בַּבֹּ֔קֶר וּמַחֲצִיתָ֖הּ בָּעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: zeh qā·rə·ban ’a·hă·rōn ū·ḇā·nāw ’ă·šer- yaq·rî·ḇū Yah·weh bə·yō·wm him·mā·šaḥ ’ō·ṯōw ‘ă·śî·riṯ hā·’ê·p̄āh sō·leṯ tā·mîḏ min·ḥāh ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯāh bab·bō·qer ū·ma·ḥă·ṣî·ṯāh bā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: This is the offering that Aaron and his sons - must present to the LORD on the day he is anointed - a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a regular grain offering half of it in the morning and half in the evening

verses.original: תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן עַֽל־ מַחֲבַ֗ת תְּבִיאֶ֑נָּה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תַּקְרִ֥יב מִנְחַ֣ת תֻּפִינֵי֙ פִּתִּ֔ים נִיחֹ֖חַ רֵֽיחַ־ לַיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: tê·‘ā·śeh baš·še·men ‘al- ma·ḥă·ḇaṯ tə·ḇî·’en·nāh mur·be·ḵeṯ taq·rîḇ min·ḥaṯ tu·p̄î·nê pit·tîm nî·ḥō·aḥ rê·aḥ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: It shall be prepared with oil on a griddle you are to bring it well-kneaded and present it as a grain offering broken in pieces a pleasing aroma to the LORD

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֵ֨ן מִבָּנָ֖יו הַמָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ עוֹלָ֕ם חָק־ לַיהוָ֖ה תָּקְטָֽר׃ כָּלִ֥יל
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hên mib·bā·nāw ham·mā·šî·aḥ taḥ·tāw ya·‘ă·śeh ’ō·ṯāh ‘ō·w·lām ḥāq- Yah·weh tā·qə·ṭār kā·lîl
verses.literal: The priest who is one of Aaron’s sons and will be anointed to take his place is to prepare it - As a permanent portion for the LORD it must be burned completely

verses.original: וְכָל־ מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl min·ḥaṯ kō·hên tih·yeh kā·lîl lō ṯê·’ā·ḵêl
verses.literal: Every grain offering for a priest shall be burned completely it is not to be eaten

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·ḏab·bêr ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַֽחַטָּ֑את בִּמְק֡וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ הָעֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הַֽחַטָּאת֙ תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- bā·nāw lê·mōr zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer hā·‘ō·lāh tiš·šā·ḥêṭ ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ tiš·šā·ḥêṭ lip̄·nê Yah·weh qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hî
verses.literal: Tell . . . Aaron . . . and his sons . . . [that] this is the law of the sin offering In the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered the sin offering shall be slaughtered before the LORD it [is] most holy . . .

verses.original: הַכֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽמְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖הּ יֹאכֲלֶ֑נָּה תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל קָדֹשׁ֙ בְּמָק֤וֹם בַּחֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hên ham·ḥaṭ·ṭê ’ō·ṯāh yō·ḵă·len·nāh tê·’ā·ḵêl qā·ḏōš bə·mā·qō·wm ba·ḥă·ṣar ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The priest who offers it shall eat it it must be eaten in a holy place in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִגַּ֥ע בִּבְשָׂרָ֖הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַאֲשֶׁ֨ר מִדָּמָהּ֙ יִזֶּ֤ה עַל־ הַבֶּ֔גֶד תְּכַבֵּ֖ס אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔יהָ קָדֹֽשׁ׃ בְּמָק֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: kōl ’ă·šer- yig·ga‘ biḇ·śā·rāh yiq·dāš wa·’ă·šer mid·dā·māh yiz·zeh ‘al- hab·be·ḡeḏ tə·ḵab·bês ’ă·šer yiz·zeh ‘ā·le·hā qā·ḏōš bə·mā·qō·wm
verses.literal: Anything that touches its flesh will become holy and if any of the blood is spattered on a garment you must wash it . . . . . . in a holy place

verses.original: חֶ֛רֶשׂ וּכְלִי־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל־ בּ֖וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְאִם־ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה נְחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ בִּכְלִ֤י וּמֹרַ֥ק וְשֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reś ū·ḵə·lî- ’ă·šer tə·ḇuš·šal- bōw yiš·šā·ḇêr wə·’im- buš·šā·lāh nə·ḥō·šeṯ biḵ·lî ū·mō·raq wə·šuṭ·ṭap̄ bam·mā·yim
verses.literal: The clay pot in which [the sin offering] is boiled must be broken if it is boiled in a bronze pot [the pot] must be scoured and rinsed with water

verses.original: כָּל־ זָכָ֥ר בַּכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתָ֑הּ הִֽוא׃ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים
verses.transliteration: kāl- zā·ḵār bak·kō·hă·nîm yō·ḵal ’ō·ṯāh hî qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm
verses.literal: Any male among the priests may eat it - it [is] most holy

verses.original: וְכָל־ לֹ֣א חַטָּ֡את אֲשֶׁר֩ תֵאָכֵ֑ל מִדָּמָ֜הּ יוּבָ֨א אֶל־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl lō ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer ṯê·’ā·ḵêl mid·dā·māh yū·ḇā ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lə·ḵap·pêr baq·qō·ḏeš bā·’êš tiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: - But no sin offering - may be eaten if its blood has been brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place . . . it must be burned
